_comment: Variant H — QUANT-3 score-band per regime. Tests whether constraining BUYs to a tight score band per regime (e.g., 70-89 in choppy, 65-95 in trending) improves PF. Hypothesis: 90+ band may be anti-predictive in some regimes (Q1-step6 finding for risk_on_choppy: n=19, PF 0.32). Run via: python3 backtest.py --portfolio --days 250 --config-override config/variants/H_score_band_per_regime.json

regime4_thresholds._comment: QUANT-3 — score_band_buy shorthand. Overrides buy_min_score + buy_max_score. Format: [lo, hi] inclusive on both ends.

risk_on_trending._band_rationale: Trending: full breadth allowed (65-95). Skip the speculative 95+ band where setups gap-up.

risk_on_choppy._band_rationale: Choppy: tight band — too low = noise, 90+ = mania-prone in choppy (Q1-step6 evidence: n=19, PF 0.32 at 90+ in choppy).

risk_off_trending._band_rationale: Risk-off: high bar; cap at 95 to avoid late-cycle blow-off tops.

panic._band_rationale: Panic: no longs. Score band irrelevant.

_caveat: Bands set from EXTRAPOLATION of single-regime evidence (choppy 90+ from Q1-step6). For trending and risk-off, the upper bound 95 is precautionary — needs per-regime score-band attribution backtest to confirm. If H underperforms baseline, the bands are wrong; tune via per-regime decompose_catalyst_trades.py output.
